name: @clossys/giver
description: The giver role: did this person get what they asked for, or a reason, or a human — and everything we owed them, on time? Dependency-free machinery for a consumer's own delivery records: a runtime verdict that is a ternary (delivered/refused/handed off, never a binary), an obligation ternary (discharged/breached/unprovable), a decision core in which no collaborator is optional and no indeterminate read can become a delivery or a bare refusal, the precedence rule between a standing refusal and a thing we owe, a ./record subpath carrying versioned standing-decision and retained-grounds document seams without cross-role imports, and three gates behind one giver-check bin — handoff-placement, which fails when a hand-off's declared service level elapsed with no placement record, when it was picked up late, when a placement predates the hand-off it answers, or when a placement names a hand-off outside the set; grounding, which fails when a delivered answer cites no source, when a refusal retains no grounds, or when either cites material the consumer no longer holds; and obligation-discharge, which fails when a fired obligation's window closed with no delivery proof, when every recorded send against it failed, when a delivery landed outside the window, or when a proof names an obligation outside the set. Ships the schema and the checkers; every consumer authors its own values.
author: Calvin Hung
